chat_typed_admission: CONSTRAINT `fk_chat_typed_admission_request` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `owner_jiacn`, `client_id`, `request_id`, `request_revision`) REFERENCES `chat_request` (`tenant_id`, `owner_jiacn`, `client_id`, `request_id`, `request_revision`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,

CONSTRAINT `chk_chat_typed_admission_digest` CHECK ((regexp_like(`request_digest`,cast(_utf8mb4'^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' as char charset binary)) and regexp_like(`body_digest`,cast(_utf8mb4'^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' as char charset binary)))),

CONSTRAINT `chk_chat_typed_admission_reply` CHECK ((((`intent` = _utf8mb4'DISCUSSION') and (`pending_question_id` is null)) or ((`intent` = _utf8mb4'CLARIFICATION_REPLY') and (`parent_outcome_id` is not null) and (`pending_question_id` is not null)))),
